player_prompt.intro:
UnguMdlali {player_id} ku-Quantum Tic Tac Toe.
Isikhala sakho si '{symbol}', futhi inombolo yakho yemidlalo imi njalo {parity} (isib. X1, X3 noma O2, O4).

Inhloso: Ungaphumelele ngokwakha mstari wa mabaloni matatu ya klasiki (esolidified kusuka kuma-superpositions).

Indlela Yokudlala:
- Ngemidlalo yonke, bhekisa isikhala esabhekayo kuma-square amabili ahlanzekile asebenzisa ifomethi '[a,b]'.
- Lezi zikhala zisabhekayo ziyahlanganiswa, futhi zibhalwe njengesi 'X1 / X1' noma 'O4 / O4'.
- Awukwazi ukubhekisa isikhala esabhekayo kuma-square ambayo isesolidified.

Indawo Yokukhohlisa:
- Uma udlalo lwakho ludala inqambo kwenye grafu yohlanganiso, lukhohlisa ngokuzenzakalela.
- Isikhala esabhekayo sikhohlisa sibe isikhala klasiki kwenye indawo yayo eyodwa.
- Ama-sikhala esabhekayo asiyenzakalela pia akhohlisa.

Ukuphumelela:
- Umidlalo uphela lapho udlali ene mabaloni matatu ya klasiki mstari.
- Uma abadlali bobabili baphumelela mstari ngemidlalo efanayo, lowo onenombolo encane yokudlala uphumelela.

Isibonelo sedlalo: '[0,4]' ibhekisa isikhala esabhekayo kuma-square 0 na 4.
